records.text: The giant golden Trump statue was financially backed by major donors from the Hasidic Jewish community rather than by Christians.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Now has a golden statue, of course, backed not by Christians financially, but by, I believe, the Hasidic Jewish community, major donors to the statue.

verification.notes: Reporting identifies Jewish or Hasidic participants among people behind the project, but the statue was bankrolled by a broader cryptocurrency-investor group promoting the PATRIOT memecoin. An evangelical pastor was instrumental in the dedication, so the exclusive contrast with Christian backing is not established.

sources.title: The New Yorker: Why Trumps spiritual adviser dedicated a golden statue
sources.relevance: Identifies a Jewish organizer and crypto investor among project participants, along with evangelical pastor Mark Burns.
